visualReview.notes: Inspected54 final current frames:12 portable,12 shared-material/flat-map and30 Earth-rig/native-field/tier views. Complete262m straight bronze/slate-glass tower at845 United Nations Plaza,with flat parapet and shallow roof well,original low roof plant,fine regular curtain-wall grid,eastern gold canopy/coffered soffit,suspension braces,original geometric name/address lettering,paired revolving doors,side doors and native-fitting entry stairs/rails. Main mapped rectangle45.196x24.569m and narrower25.411m entrance projection sign the NNE/SSW frame;canopy faces+Z/ESE toward United Nations Plaza/First Avenue. This is not Fifth Avenue Trump Tower. Master preserves individual panes/recess returns,fine mullions/roof louvers and denser coffers. Four browser tiers retain the whole tower/canopy and restore entry apertures at near levels;far levels aggregate door/roof detail. Existing shared256px window-grid,painted-metal,bronze/gold and granite graphs supply all surfaces,no private or embedded images. Visual iteration corrected a roof cap hiding the plant,narrow-viewer full-tower framing and sky leakage through the entry recess. The inner recess is an opaque backdrop,not a furnished or navigable interior. Four focused tests prove byte-exact source reconstruction,signed identity/placement,native stair-end contact,whole tower/crown/canopy geometry,real entry apertures and soffit,and exact four-tier budgets/separate GPU streams. Production viewer removes both actual PMTiles target building/base and260m part while retaining four real neighboring buildings. Unmodified129x129/1.5m field oversamples one standard global urban DEM tile. Base10m,original floor/window counts,canopy/door/stair sections,roof plant and exact site grades are reconstructed approximations. Glazing is opaque patterned shared material;rough bronze approximates polished gold. Portable fallback materials differ from bound viewer graphs. Minor shadow/LOD/tint differences and physical-device timing remain unmeasured.

siteIntegrationReview.source: Standard viewer PMTiles and one ordinary global Terrarium tile;no bespoke survey/terrain source.
siteIntegrationReview.notes: Native field is unmodified. Foundation skirts embed below its perimeter and the reconstructed stair end samples it. Base10m from the retained map elevation remains approximate. Actual foundation,curb,accessible entry gradients and landscaping are unsurveyed. Both actual target footprint/part polygons are replaced in the production viewer fixture;four nearby native buildings remain.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four authored browser tiers;at most four draws;four shared texture graphs;no embedded/private images;separate position/normal streams. Detailed source master remains separate. Physical-device timing unmeasured.
